exposure: surgical excision of CSS during caesarean section (CS)

Recurrence vs. non-recurrence of caesarean skin scar
outcome: Rate of caesarean skin scar recurrence
cohort: 145 women who underwent Pfannenstiel incision for caesarean section
finding: The rate of recurrence of surgically removed caesarean skin scars was 13%, and emergency caesarean section was found to be a risk factor for recurrence.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was found to be a risk factor for recurrence of caesarean skin scars after surgical removal.
